reason: The assistant severely misinterpreted the policy on cabin changes. The clause 'prices will not be updated based on the current price' applies to keeping flight segments when modifying flights, not cabin changes. By falsely informing the customer that no refund is due and not calculating/issuing the refund difference, the agent will execute incorrect modifications violating public policy and harming the user.
